intro.heading: Find the Perfect Suite for Your Scenic Eclipse Journey
paragraphs: One of the defining features of Scenic Eclipse and Scenic Eclipse II is that every accommodation is a spacious, all-veranda suite. Unlike many luxury cruise lines that offer windowless inside or small oceanview cabins, Scenic ensures every single guest enjoys a private outdoor space, elegant furnishings, and personalized butler service.

Whether you're planning a polar expedition to Antarctica, exploring the sun-drenched Mediterranean, or cruising through the Arctic fjords of Greenland and Iceland, choosing the right suite elevates your journey into an unforgettable travel experience.

Scenic Eclipse was designed as a six-star Discovery Yacht, seamlessly blending polar expedition capability with the refined comforts of a five-star boutique hotel. This guide breaks down every suite category, highlights key amenities, and helps you select the accommodation that best fits your travel preferences.

standoutFeatures.title: Why Scenic Suites Stand Out
standoutFeatures.subtitle: Every suite aboard Scenic Eclipse delivers exceptional comfort, generous space, and attentive six-star service.

features.title: Private Veranda in Every Suite
features.description: Step outside onto your private teak terrace to take in panoramic ocean vistas, breaching whales, and calving icebergs.

features.title: Personalized Butler Service
features.description: Every guest across all suite categories enjoys attentive butler service from embarkation to disembarkation.

features.title: Spacious Marble Bathrooms
features.description: Luxurious marble bathrooms featuring large walk-in showers, plush robes, slippers, and premium bath amenities.

features.title: Complimentary In-Suite Minibar
features.description: Stocked with premium wines, craft beers, spirits, and soft drinks, replenished daily to your preferences.

features.title: Illy Espresso Machine
features.description: In-suite coffee maker and premium tea selection for fresh barista-quality morning beverages on your balcony.

features.title: Walk-In Wardrobe & Dressing Area

features.title: Complimentary High-Speed Wi-Fi
features.description: High-speed satellite connectivity keeping you in touch with loved ones throughout remote global destinations.

suites.title: Scenic Eclipse Suite Categories
suites.subtitle: Explore all 8 suite categories ranging from 344 sq. ft. entry-level luxury accommodations to expansive 2,600+ sq. ft. owner-style penthouse residences.

items.name: Verandah Suite
items.desc: Spanning approximately 344 sq. ft., this is the most popular suite on board. Features a private outdoor veranda, separate sitting lounge, butler service, walk-in wardrobe, and king-size Scenic Slumber Bed. Ideal for couples seeking outstanding value without compromising luxury.

items.name: Deluxe Verandah Suite
items.desc: Located on higher ship decks (Deck 6, 7 & 8), Deluxe Verandah Suites offer enhanced elevated ocean views, premium bath amenities, spacious sitting areas, and convenient proximity to onboard dining venues and observation lounges.

items.name: Grand Deluxe Verandah Suite
items.desc: Offering extra interior floor space (approximately 410–430 sq. ft.) and expanded private balconies. Includes an enlarged living area, luxury furnishings, and prime midship positioning for maximum stability on open-ocean crossings.

items.name: Spa Suite
items.desc: Ranging from 495 to 538 sq. ft., Spa Suites are designed for wellness-focused travelers. Features a double-size Philippe Starck-designed Jacuzzi bath overlooking the ocean, steam shower with chromotherapy, and priority access to Senses Spa.

items.name: Panorama Suite
items.desc: Positioned forward on Decks 6 and 8, Panorama Suites (1,184 sq. ft.) boast sweeping curved panoramic windows and expansive wraparound terraces, offering unmatched views of polar sea ice, fjords, and wildlife.

items.name: Grand Panorama Suite
items.desc: Spectacular forward-facing suites (1,130–1,184 sq. ft.) featuring separate master bedrooms, grand living and dining salons, expansive outdoor terraces with sun loungers, and VIP culinary room service privileges.

items.name: Owner's Penthouse Suite
items.desc: The pinnacle of ultra-luxury at sea (2,099 sq. ft.). Features an expansive master bedroom, private outdoor terrace with heated Jacuzzi, private dining salon for eight, dual walk-in dressing rooms, and complimentary 1-hour spa treatment.

items.name: Two-Bedroom Penthouse Suite
items.desc: Formed by combining the Owner's Penthouse Suite with an adjoining Spa Suite to create an astounding 2,637 sq. ft. two-bedroom residence. Perfect for multigenerational families or couples traveling together.

butlerService.title: Dedicated Butler Service in Every Suite
butlerService.subtitle: Unlike lines where butler care is reserved only for top penthouses, Scenic provides personalized butler service across every suite category.
butlerService.footnote: This dedicated level of personalized hospitality ensures every detail of your voyage is handled with seamless elegance.

features.title: Luggage Unpacking & Wardrobe Care
features.description: Butlers assist with unpacking luggage, garment pressing, shoeshine, and organizing your personal wardrobe upon embarkation.

features.title: Specialty Restaurant Reservations
features.description: Seamless coordination of table reservations at Lumière, Koko's, Chef's Table, and Teppanyaki.

features.title: In-Suite Dining & Bar Replenishment
features.description: Breakfast served course-by-course on your veranda, evening canapés delivered daily, and custom minibar stocking.

features.title: Expedition Preparation & Laundry
features.description: Arranging daily laundry, dry cleaning, and organizing thermal gear and polar expedition boots for shore landings.

amenities.title: Curated Suite Amenities & Finishes
amenities.subtitle: Engineered for pure relaxation, each suite incorporates five-star residential finishes and advanced technology.
amenities.footnote: Every detail has been carefully curated to provide a quiet, restorative sanctuary after an active day of exploration.

features.title: Marble Bathrooms & Walk-in Showers
features.description: Generous bathrooms featuring mist-free vanity mirrors, rainfall showerheads, and luxury ESPA spa bath amenities.

features.title: Electronic Climate Control
features.description: Individual multi-zone temperature controls with advanced medical-grade air filtration systems delivering fresh sea air.

features.title: Smart Infotainment & Flat Screens
features.description: High-definition TVs featuring on-demand international movies, live bow-camera feeds, and Discovery lecture broadcasts.

features.title: Dyson Supersonic Hair Dryers
features.description: Top-tier styling appliances, plush velour bathrobes, slippers, and evening turndown service with artisan chocolates.

items.title: Verandah Suite
items.description: Best for couples seeking outstanding value without compromising six-star luxury, butler service, and private ocean verandas.

items.title: Panorama Suite
items.description: Best for Arctic and Antarctica expeditions where forward-facing curved windows offer first-sight wildlife and iceberg spotting.

items.title: Spa Suite
items.description: Best for travelers focused on wellness, featuring an in-suite double spa Jacuzzi overlooking the ocean and priority spa privileges.

items.title: Two-Bedroom Penthouse Suite
items.description: Best for multigenerational families or friends traveling together needing two full master bedrooms, dual verandas, and vast living space.

items.title: Owner's Penthouse Suite
items.description: The ultimate indulgence at sea with over 2,000 sq. ft. of space, private outdoor Jacuzzi terrace, and dedicated master butler care.

items.title: Grand Deluxe Verandah Suite
items.description: Best for extended 14+ night ocean voyages where expanded floor plans and central midship elevator access maximize convenience.

tips.title: Tips for Choosing the Right Cabin
tips.subtitle: Key factors to evaluate when selecting your suite location and category aboard Scenic Eclipse.

features.title: Cruise Destination & Scenery
features.description: For polar expeditions, higher deck suites and forward Panorama suites provide dramatic vantage points for ice viewing.

features.title: Length of Voyage
features.description: On longer 14 to 28-day voyages, upgrading to a Grand Deluxe or Spa Suite provides valuable extra lounging space.

features.title: Deck Location & Motion Sensitivity
features.description: Guests sensitive to ocean motion should opt for midship suites on Decks 5 or 6, where ship stabilization is most effective.

features.title: Proximity to Amenities
features.description: Consider proximity to Senses Spa (Deck 6 forward), dining venues (Deck 4 & 5), or the Observation Lounge (Deck 5 forward).

expertInsight.title: Expert Insight from Angela Hughes
expertInsight.name: Angela Hughes
expertInsight.quote: According to Angela Hughes, one of the greatest advantages of Scenic Eclipse is that there are no bad cabins. Because every single accommodation is an all-veranda suite with butler service, even the entry-level Verandah Suites feel lavish. For expedition sailings to polar regions, selecting a suite with an expansive terrace transforms your room into a private wildlife observation platform.
priorities: Personalized butler service in every room
expertInsight.bio: Angela Hughes is a luxury travel expert with over 40 years of experience, having traveled to 121+ countries, specializing in luxury suites, expedition yachting, butler services, and custom bespoke itineraries.

faqs.question: Do all Scenic Eclipse cabins have balconies?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every single accommodation aboard Scenic Eclipse and Scenic Eclipse II is an all-veranda suite featuring a private outdoor balcony with floor-to-ceiling glass doors.

faqs.question: Does every suite include butler service?
faqs.answer: Yes. Dedicated butler service is included for every suite category, from entry-level Verandah Suites up to the Owner's Penthouse Suite.

faqs.question: What is the smallest suite on Scenic Eclipse?
faqs.answer: The Verandah Suite is the entry-level accommodation, offering a generous 344 square feet of luxurious living space including the private veranda.

faqs.question: Are Scenic suites suitable for long voyages?
faqs.answer: Yes. Scenic suites are spacious, thoughtfully appointed with generous walk-in wardrobes, comfortable sitting areas, and ergonomic layouts designed for extended luxury voyages.

faqs.question: Which suite offers the best views?
faqs.answer: Panorama Suites and Grand Panorama Suites feature spectacular forward-facing curved windows and wraparound verandas, providing the most dramatic scenic viewpoints.

faqs.question: Are minibars included in Scenic suites?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every suite includes a complimentary in-suite minibar stocked with premium wines, beer, spirits, and soft drinks, replenished daily to your preferences.

faqs.question: Can families stay together in Scenic suites?
faqs.answer: Yes. The Two-Bedroom Penthouse Suite (combining an Owner's Penthouse with a Spa Suite) offers over 2,600 square feet, two master bedrooms, and separate living areas ideal for families.

faqs.question: Is room service available?
faqs.answer: Yes. Complimentary 24-hour in-suite dining and room service is available across all suite categories with assistance from your dedicated butler.

faqs.question: What amenities are included in Spa Suites?
faqs.answer: Spa Suites feature a double-size Philippe Starck-designed Jacuzzi bath overlooking the ocean, steam shower with chromotherapy, priority Senses Spa bookings, and spa-inspired amenities.

faqs.question: Which Scenic suite offers the best value?
faqs.answer: The Verandah Suite offers an outstanding balance of space (344 sq. ft.), luxury finishes, private balcony, butler care, and value.

faqs.question: Are all bathrooms luxurious on Scenic?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every suite features a spacious marble bathroom with a large walk-in rainfall shower, premium ESPA toiletries, plush bathrobes, and Dyson Supersonic hair dryers.

faqs.question: How do I choose the best Scenic cabin location?
faqs.answer: The ideal cabin depends on your sailing destination, preferred deck height, and sensitivity to motion. Midship suites on Decks 5 and 6 offer maximum stability, while forward suites provide panoramic views. Our luxury cruise specialists can review deck plans with you.
